description: pkix-lint/tests/cabf_tls_br_tests.rs lines 308-324: The only negative test for Sha1ProhibitedLint (a cert that should Error) is marked #[ignore] because the fixture does not exist. The test instructions are in the comment (openssl req -x509 ... -sha1). Without the fixture, the "SHA-1 cert returns Error" path is not tested at all. The sha1_prohibited_oid_detection_logic test (lines 272-291) only verifies that two OID constants are different from known SHA-256 OIDs — it does not verify the lint returns Error for a SHA-1 cert. The ignored test should be generated and committed per test integrity requirements.
title: P3: Sha1ProhibitedLint has no fixture test for SHA-1 cert (positive case) — negative test is #[ignore]d
